function.name: match_tax_jurisdictions
function.description: Submit the matched tax jurisdictions for each Shopify tax line.

jurisdiction_code.description: The matched BC Tax Jurisdiction Code; a newly suggested code when auto-create is enabled and the tax line is a genuine tax; the exact value "UNKNOWN" when the title is not a genuine tax description; or empty string if no confident match and auto-create is disabled

reason.description: Brief explanation of why this match was chosen; one short sentence
